allow: Bash(timeout 40 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done')
PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 3000,3001 } | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize)
PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 3000,3001 } | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess)
